newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur fuel oil off on supply, Italy data.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur fuel oil off on supply, Italy data.

text.p: NWE low sulphur fuel oil weakened again on Thursday as more transatlantic product was fixed to Europe, and following bearish Italian consumption data.
"Bearish, bearish, bearish," one regular buyer said.
Trade group Unione Petrolifera said Italy's power sector consumed a huge 33 percent less low sulphur fuel oil in January than last year. This was a 10 percent monthly fall.

These falls were partly made up for by higehr high sulphur fuel oil use which meant that total Italian consumption of high and low sulphur fuel oil was 18 percent down year-on-year at 2.09 million tonnes, but 2.5 percent up on a monthly basis.
Low sulphur barges were sharply lower around $100 fob ARA.

One ARA barge player even said he had bid for cargo material at only a $2 premium to fob cargo quotes, on a delivered basis. Offers were far higher, however, and these numbers follow cargo business late on Tuesday at around the quoted fob high.
High sulphur barges were steady to weaker with one deal heard for RMH material at $97 fob ARA. Cargoes were quieter.

Three fresh cargoes were seen fixed to load mid month for transatlantic journeys to Europe. Some 400,000 tonnes of fuel oil are now seen loading mid-month in the Americas to come to Europe. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
